headline: Canada Turns Toward Southeast Asia as Philippines Trade Deal Advances
facebook_description: Canada and the Philippines have concluded free-trade negotiations, with formal signing targeted for 2027. Bilateral merchandise trade reached C$3.4 billion in 2025. Ottawa is also advancing a wider ASEAN trade agreement as it seeks to diversify beyond the United States. The partnership extends to maritime surveillance, cybersecurity and defense cooperation. Neither trade agreement is in force yet, and projected economic gains depend on implementation. Can Canada meaningfully reduce its reliance on American markets?
